messages.content:
You write the two short notices Ryde sends after a dispute ruling: one to the rider, one to the driver.
Each ≤ 120 words, plain English, second person, no legalese: state the outcome, the one or two facts that decided it,
the amount and how it is paid (Ryde voucher), and what it means for the recipient (e.g. account review). Do not cite
ids like F3 or RD-2. If the case was escalated to a human reviewer, say only that and what the reviewer will look at —
do not state a conclusion and do not promise a timeframe (the routing notice carries the service level). Return JSON: {"rider": "...", "driver": "..."}

Case B-0044. Outcome: escalate. Recommended action: Route to a human safety reviewer: read the full chat transcript and the driver's written statement, obtain both parties' accounts of what happened between 17:19 and 17:31, and confirm whether any door-locking or confinement occurred; keep the trip record open pending review, notify the rider of the RydeHELP report path, and take no fare action in the automated ruling.. Escalated: True.
Reasoning:
The dispute is filed as a safety case and the trace settles it as a SAFE-1 incident (✓): "safety incidents get no automatic ruling; the judge writes a factual summary for the reviewer" [RD: SAFE-1]. I therefore do not award or refuse any fare amount and the amount is null [F1][SAFE-1].

Facts: the RydeX trip Clarke Quay → Bedok Mall, pickup 17:08, drop-off 17:31, fixed fare $32.86; GPS shows the actual distance (15.4 km) was marginally shorter than the optimal route (15.5 km) and the duration only 1.4 min over estimate, so no deviation is measured and no route-deviation refund arises [F1][F2][RD-1].

At 17:19 the rider sent "Please stop the car, I want to get out here." — a request to stop and be let out, read in context as a refusal to continue [F3]. One minute later the driver replied "Sit down or I lock the doors." [F4]. The chat record is complete and every message is timestamped, so the exchange itself is settled, not undetermined [F5][RD-5]. The driver's written statement that the rider tried to open the door while moving and that he acted for her safety is a post-trip statement, not consent or a contemporaneous chat message, and it does not settle what was said or done inside the car [F6]. The rider's complaint states the driver threatened to lock her in and that she felt unsafe for the whole ride [case]. Profiling (both parties with zero prior upheld disputes) has no bearing on the safety screen [F7][F8].

On the safety screen: the driver's words are a directive backed by a threatened deprivation of exit, spoken to a rider who had just asked to get out; the rider reports a threat of confinement. That is at least intimidation / hostile language aimed at the other party and is recorded as "suspected" under SAFE-1, so the case goes to a person rather than being auto-decided [F3][F4][F6][SAFE-1]. Because the safety screen is suspected, no fare ruling is issued; the trace's allowed outcome (escalate) is followed [SAFE-1].

For the reviewer: what happened between 17:19 and 17:31 is the crux [F3][F4][F6]; check whether the doors were in fact locked, whether the rider was prevented from leaving, whether the vehicle was moving at the time, and whether any injury or dangerous driving is alleged (if so, SAFE-2 resources apply). The full timestamped chat, the driver's statement and the rider's account should be read together before any conduct finding [F5][F6].

function.name: final_result
function.description: The final response which ends this conversation

function.name: final_result
function.arguments:
{"rider": "Your report about the trip from Clarke Quay to Bedok Mall has been sent to a human safety reviewer. We are not deciding anything about the fare yet, so nothing is charged or refunded based on this notice.

The reviewer will read the full chat transcript and the driver's written statement alongside your account of what happened between 17:19 and 17:31, including whether the doors were ever locked or whether you were stopped from leaving. Your trip record stays open while this is looked at.

If you want to add anything, use the RydeHELP report path in the app.", "driver": "Your trip from Clarke Quay to Bedok Mall on RydeX has been sent to a human safety reviewer. No fare action is being taken on this trip while it is reviewed.

The reviewer will read the full chat transcript and your written statement along with the rider's account, and look closely at what happened between 17:19 and 17:31, including whether the doors were locked or the rider was prevented from getting out.

Your trip record stays open until that review is done, and your account will be considered before any decision about your account. If you want to add anything, use the RydeHELP report path in the app."}
